Planning Document: docs/dcps/INNERWEST/Marrickville/Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 24 Marrickville Town Centre South.pdf

Clause 9.24.2 - parking (development_control): To ensure that the provision and locatio n of off -street car parking does not adversely impact the amenity of the precinct.

Clause 9.24.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect and preserve the identified period buildings within the precinct and encourage their sympathetic alteration or restoration.

Clause 9.24.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect the identified Heritage Items  within the precinct.

Clause 9.24.2 - height_limit (development_control): To maintain distinctly single storey streetscapes that exist within the precinct.

Clause 9.24.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect groups or runs of buildings which retain their original built form including roof forms, original detailing and finishes.

Clause 9.24.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect  significant streetscapes  and/or public domain elements within the precinct including landscaping, fencing, open space, sandstone kerbing and guttering, views and vistas and prevailing subdivision p atterns.

Clause 9.24.2 - zoning (development_control): To preserve the predominantly low density residen tial character of the precinct.
